## `pygeovision.models.foundation.prithvi`

Prithvi-EO -- NASA/IBM geospatial foundation models, integrated for PyGeoVision.

|---|---|---|

| `PrithviMultiTemporal` | class | Multi-date analysis in Prithvi's feature space. |
